publication_standard: CTL Phase 0 as amended (Amendment A1, 2026-10-30): verified rows only — grade_master as stored in {VERIFIED, STRONG EVIDENCE}; relationships publish only when both endpoints publish; photos and conflict notes publish with their entities.
license: CC BY 4.0 (dataset); photographs remain under their own licenses — see photos.csv

files.entities.csv/json: One row/object per published entity (3488). Grades are carried per store and never merged.
files.relationships.csv/json: One row/object per published relationship (2628). evidenced_by names the store(s) attesting the edge.
files.conflicts.csv: Every preserved disagreement attached to a published entity (491 notes), labeled by class.
files.photos.csv: The per-image evidence record for each photograph attached to a published entity (205): creator, source, license, credit line.

grade_scales.grade_master: Canonical CSV master scale: VERIFIED / STRONG EVIDENCE / UNVERIFIED.
grade_scales.grade_build: Build-graph scale under CTL-GOV-006: Verified = at least two independent sources including one authoritative; otherwise Provisional.

id_note: union_id (U-NNNNN) is the dataset id. master_ids and build_ids preserve each store’s own identifiers; the two stores’ CTL-E- strings are NOT interchangeable (221 known collisions) — cite the union_id.
